rationale: The browser capture no longer reads the materialized document for an import that passes --omit-materialized-document just because the document serves @font-face fonts from Blob URLs. Those faces are already read in the page into font-faces.json, which is the only record the native importer attaches fonts from; the document's font_bindings had no remaining consumer. A plain IR import of a Blob-font bundle keeps the same faces and asset ids and no longer writes materialized-document.json. No lowering rule or DesignIR schema changes, and Chromium stays the oracle.
